facts.fact: In the last dark before first light after ch13, Ammu, in jackal shape on the second spur, gives the guild call (three yips, pause, one rising note: 'tomorrow, I will find you') after finding the stone empty. Neela hears it in shape and cannot answer. At dawn she reads 'tomorrow' as the coming day and expects Ammu at the gate by the gate-bell as Valli. This replaces the earlier first-light version.
When Janu returns and asks where Neela is, Devan tells her flatly that he sent Neela to sleep. Neela, behind the curtain in shape, hears the lie and takes it for fevered kindness.
